title: PCOS-ATLAS: a provenance-verified, de-duplicated harmonised PCOS corpus and transfer benchmark
description:
A harmonised corpus and leave-one-collection-out transfer benchmark built from 33 publicly available PCOS dataset entries.

Result. The 33 entries resolve to 27 distinct collections, of which 6 pass all six inclusion rules. Five form a 1,425-record binary-label core across four countries (503 positive, 35.3%). A six-fold leave-one-collection-out transfer benchmark reaches a mean AUROC of 0.676, against within-dataset accuracies above 95% reported in the literature. Of 13 image entries, one survives verification (295 images).

No source data are redistributed. Two of the six sources are licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and unspecified respectively, which prohibit redistribution. fetch.py retrieves each source from its original publisher and verifies it against a recorded SHA-256 before the build proceeds; build_harmonized.py then regenerates every table and figure in the accompanying paper from those verified files.

Contents. Harmonisation and verification code, source manifest with per-file hashes, the 33-entry exclusion catalogue, the duplicate registry, leave-one-collection-out split definitions, the image registry and the baseline.
notes: The source datasets retain their original licences. Kottarathil (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0), Chaabouni (CC BY 4.0), Gawron (CC0 1.0), Sahil Koli (CC0), hasaanrana (unspecified), Kurdistan (CC BY 4.0). Cite each source collection when using this corpus.
